title: hoffmannia regalis
intro: Hoffmannia regalis, commonly known as the Royal Hoffmannia or the Red Coral, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various infections, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hoffmannia regalis include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Hoffmannia regalis also exhibit antioxidant and cytotoxic activities, making it a subject of interest in modern medicine for its potential therapeutic applications.
